gold.sql:
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(metric_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  SUM(new_users) AS value
FROM growth_daily_metrics
WHERE
  metric_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND metric_date < CAST('2026-08-29' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  1
SELECT user_id, registered_at FROM user_registrations WHERE registered_at >= DATE '1900-01-01' AND registered_at < DATE '1900-01-02' ORDER BY user_id LIMIT 20

execution_log.label: 转化事件数
execution_log.description: 按渠道产生的转化事件数量从高到低排序
execution_log.question: 请问“表现最好”具体是指哪个指标最高？

arguments.sql:
SELECT
  ac.channel_name,
  COUNT(cce.conversion_event_id) AS conversion_event_count
FROM askdata_ops.channel_conversion_events cce
JOIN askdata_ops.acquisition_channels ac ON cce.channel_id = ac.channel_id
WHERE cce.converted_at >= '2026-05-01'::timestamp
  AND cce.converted_at < '2026-06-01'::timestamp
GROUP BY ac.channel_name
ORDER BY conversion_event_count DESC
LIMIT 200

result.sql:
SELECT
  ac.channel_name,
  COUNT(cce.conversion_event_id) AS conversion_event_count
FROM askdata_ops.channel_conversion_events cce
JOIN askdata_ops.acquisition_channels ac ON cce.channel_id = ac.channel_id
WHERE cce.converted_at >= '2026-05-01'::timestamp
  AND cce.converted_at < '2026-06-01'::timestamp
GROUP BY ac.channel_name
ORDER BY conversion_event_count DESC
LIMIT 200

execution_log.reason: 根据用户确认的口径，统计2026年5月各渠道的转化事件数，并按数量降序排列以找出表现最好的渠道。使用channel_conversion_events表作为事实来源，通过channel_id关联acquisition_channels获取渠道名称。

GROUP BY ac.channel_name
ORDER BY conversion_event_count DESC
LIMIT 200
